messages:
incident-bot: ALERT fired: latency.p99 > 450ms across prod-eu (rule: inference.latency.p99) -- 23s ago. Links: https://ops.metrics/redwood/alerts/1777770001 :rotating_light:
pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident INC-987654 triggered (Latency SLO burn). Policy: page -> ack -> escalate.
kevin.h: acked on pagerduty, i'm taking it. looking at traces now.
maria.s: thanks kevin. i'm on metrics. p95 up ~220ms, p99 ~520ms over last 2m.
oliver: seeing spike coincident with a big retrain job hitting dedicated pools? checking scheduler.
sophia: confirmed a burst of long-context requests from eu-west-2, maybe model variant fallback causing longer kv cache warmups.
kevin.h: can someone check GPU mem pressure on rdw-dedicated-eu-*-pods? `kubectl top pods -n inference | grep eu`
maria.s: past 5m avg GPU util ~98% on shard-eu-3, OOM events 2 in last 10m, evictions?
kevin.h: dropping non-critical routes to fallback tier for now. Executing: `redwood route update --namespace prod --route /assistant --tier best-effort`
deploy-bot: Rollout started: route change `best-effort` -> applied to 4/6 clusters.
oliver: scheduler shows a `batch_replay` job started at 00:12:03 UTC, looks heavy. paging infra to pause. @sre-lead FYI might need to throttle retrain bursts.
sophia: customer-impact check: outgoing latency-sensitive routes (client-facing) have elevated error budget consumption but no 5xx spikes. ticketing: possible UX degradation on long chats.
kevin.h: rolling a hotfix: reduce max-batch-size on eu pods from 32 -> 8: `redwood config set batch.max 8 --selector region=eu`
maria.s: metrics dropping already: p99 down from 520 -> 260 in 90s. p95 back to ~160ms. good sign.
kevin.h: staying on this, will handoff in 20m unless things reflare.
oliver: paused the batch_replay job via autoscheduler: `autoscheduler cancel job/batch_replay-2026-03-15-0012`
sophia: leaving a note for post-incident: investigate KV cache sticky hotkeys causing uneven p99.
sre-lead: great mitigation. escalate to infra team to throttle offline replay jobs long-term. Also open a change to add resource quota guard.
kevin.h: PD status -> acknowledged -> assigned to kevin.h. escalation suppressed.
maria.s: added ephemeral dashboard link: https://dash.ops/redwood/latest?view=eu-latency-quick
kevin.h: will post a short summary in 15m for rotation. if it holds, we'll close after 30m with RCA follow-ups.
pagerduty: Note: 1 ack, 0 escalations, responders: kevin.h.
sophia: quick log snippet where the slow event correlates:
```
2026-03-15T00:12:05Z INFO request_id=abc123 model=redwood-llama kv_cache_miss=1 step=decode latency_ms=512
2026-03-15T00:12:06Z WARN gpu_mem_pct=98 host=shard-eu-3 batch_size=28
```
kevin.h: marking incident triaged. leaving open until p99 < 300ms for 10m window.
maria.s: p99 at 210ms now, hold for 10m.
oliver: filed INF-342: throttle offline replays + quota guard.
sre-lead: thanks all — handoff to morning rotation if still stable. add timeline + ops items in incident doc. :white_check_mark:
